content.text: {"answer":"None of the supplied papers directly address maximizing income for power conversion tools and cells specifically by using actual device behavior in Nordic power exchanges. [1] instead focuses on incorporating experimental performance into a price-driven optimization for a battery and a power-to-X electrolyser, using real market data from Denmark (Danish electricity and ancillary service markets), but it does not target Nordic exchanges. [1] reports optimized daily profits for multi-market participation for the BESS and electrolyser.\n\nThe other provided papers cover topics such as battery power prediction for EVs, ranking fairness with context-dependent “income,” power consumption modeling for virtualized O-RANs, scheduling for cooperative electricity-heat systems, and other deep learning/control applications; they do not discuss power conversion tools/cells maximizing income on Nordic power exchanges, nor device-behavior-driven participation in those markets.
